topic: The actor who stayed in character for 3 full years and lost their mind
hook: He stayed in character for 3 years. He lost his mind.
script: He stayed in character for 3 years. He lost his mind. Jim Carrey adopted the method acting approach for his portrayal of Andy Kaufman in Man on the Moon so completely that he refused to answer to his own name on set for 9 months. He terrorised crew members in character. He caused multiple co-stars to genuinely hate him. He has since said the experience left him uncertain about his own identity. Method acting claimed another victim. Follow for actors who paid too high a price for their craft.
